list.title: Groups
list.emptyBody: A group is a flat, a trip, or the two of you. Everything else hangs off one.

closed.banner: This group is closed. Reopen it to add expenses.
closed.bannerSettling: This group is closed, but you can still record a payment.

create.title: New group
create.description: You can add the others once it exists.
create.emailHint: Anyone without an account yet gets an invite link once the group is created.
create.badEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.

members.weightExplainer: A weight splits things in proportion — a share of 2 is twice a share of 1. It is only used when an expense is split by shares.
members.departedSubtitle: Left. Their past expenses and any balance still count.
members.departedNote: Leaving does not erase a debt. Someone who has left still appears in the balances until they are square, and can still be paid.
members.addDescription: They need a StudentWise account already.
members.weightDescription: Used when an expense is split by shares.
members.weightError: Has to be a number above zero.

danger.closeBody: No new expenses can be added. You can reopen it at any time, and anything still owed can still be settled.
danger.deleteBody: Every expense, split and settlement in it goes too. This cannot be undone. To keep the record, close the group instead.
danger.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the group's name to confirm

suggestions.label: Add people
suggestions.hint: People from your other groups. Anyone else, by email.

partialFailure.one: Group created, but {count} person could not be added.
partialFailure.other: Group created, but {count} people could not be added.

invite.title: Invite to {group}
invite.description: Anyone with this link can join {group}, signing up first if they need to. It works for 14 days.
invite.message: Join {group} on StudentWise, so we can split our expenses: {url}
invite.subject: Join {group} on StudentWise
invite.noAccount: {email} doesn't have a StudentWise account yet. Send an invite link instead.
invite.forWhom: These people don't have an account yet. Send them the link: {emails}

join.title: Join a group
join.closed: This group is closed, so it isn't taking new members.
join.invalid: This invite link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
